The '''''Lucrehulk''-class battleship''' was the primary [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Trade Defense Force]]. Most ''Lucrehulks'' were modified from enormous [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|cargo haulers]].<ref name="E1:ICS" /> Upgraded and modified versions were later used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="DS" /> the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]<ref name="NEGTVAV" /> and the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[The Colony|Colony]].<ref name="DNIII:TSW" /> Some ''Lucrehulk''-class battleships were equipped with an array of transmitters and broadcasting equipment, allowing them to serve as '''Droid Control Ships'''.

==Characteristics==
At over three kilometers in diameter, the enormous vessel closely resembled a torus that was missing a section of its circumference, holding a central sphere that contained the ship's bridge and reactor assemblies. The front void of the craft held two behemoth docking bays on either side, which were lined with forward docking claws. These gigantic cargo vessels had been built for many years by the Trade Federation to haul cargo between planets and were an important asset to their enterprise.<ref name="E1:ICS" />

[[File:TFDCS_ep1ig.png|thumb|left|250px|Schematics of the ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]
Housed in the stern of the main body were the main reactors, each connected to one of the three main engines, as well as to secondary engines and each other. The central sphere housed its own reactor/power generator assemblies.<ref name="E1:ICS" />

Lining the equatorial bands in batteries of three were [[Quad turbolaser cannon/Legends|quad turbolaser cannons]] capable of rotating inwards when not in use. Their limited coverage of the hull made the early [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] models vulnerable and made them rely more on the massive number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] carried to defend the ships against enemy starfighters. This was, however, rectified with later ships whose armor and shields proved too strong for starfighter firepower, the fact becoming quickly apparent at the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="E1:ICS" /> The pre&ndash;Clone Wars models of the battleships did have major defense flaws, as Anakin Skywalker was able to fly his starfighter into the hangar of a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] and destroy the starboard main reactor by accident. The resulting explosion destroyed the battleship and ensured a Naboo victory.

===Clone Wars&ndash;era battleship===
''Lucrehulk''-class battleships that fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had less trouble with weak spots, as they were augmented with gun batteries and much stronger shielding. Batteries of [[long gun]]s and [[heavy gun]]s complemented the additional quad turbolaser batteries added to the ''Lucrehulk'' superstructure when the war erupted.<ref name="ROTS" /><ref name="GG">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/galactic/2006/02/galactic20060208.html|series=Galactic Gallery|text=Gun Guide}}</ref>

[[File:TF_Hangar.png|thumb|left|250px|A hangar bay with [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]]]]
Each ship was also now so powerful due to the increased amount of power devoted to offensive and defensive systems that a whole [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] was needed just to bring down a ''Lucrehulk''{{'s}} shields.<ref name="ROTS:ICS2">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The Clone Wars refitted models were true battleships and were among the most powerful ships in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. Due to their firepower and strong shielding and armor, and large starfighter complements, these battleships were often used as command ships and as blockade vessels.

==History==
===Origins===
When the Trade Federation began creating its military, the Executive Board realized the need for large [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] to transport their weapons across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], battleships to defend against starfighter attacks, and [[Flagship/Legends|flagships]] for controlling their vast legions of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Reluctant to spend the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] necessary to construct and purchase a fleet of military vessels, the Trade Federation began modifying a portion of its many thousands<ref name="OSAVC33">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 33|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 33]]</ref> of ''Lucrehulk''-class freighters into [[Warship/Legends|warships]].<ref name="E1:ICS" /> Their early navy had about 10% of all ''Lucrehulk''s converted to battleships and by the battle of Naboo, it was estimated that 35% of the class had undergone refitting.<ref name="OSAVC33" />

===Invasion of Naboo===
[[File:Lucrehulk_blockade.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A blockade battleship over Naboo]]
The Trade Federation used a substantial fleet of ''Lucrehulk''-class battleships to enforce the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]], led by the flagship [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']].<ref name="SWEI:TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>
The most important vessel in the Trade Federation's blockade was the ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|''Vuutun Palaa'']]. When the rest of the blockade dispersed after Naboo was successfully occupied, the Neimoidians left the Droid Control Ship in orbit to coordinate their droid forces. The Control Ship was later destroyed by the young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], resulting in the deactivation of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]].<ref name="OSAVC33" /><ref name="SWEI:TPM" />

[[File:Trade_Federation_turbolasers.png|thumb|250px|Three [[Quad turbolaser cannon/Legends|quad turbolaser cannons]] on a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] battleship]]
After the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the Republic ordered the Trade Federation to disband its military forces. The crafty Trade Federation pretended to comply with this command by apparently disassembling most of its battleships, only to transform their centrispheres into detachable [[Core ship/Legends|core ships]] capable of carrying supplies<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> as well as increasing the battleship's armaments.<ref name="OSAVC33" />

In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], two of these vessels were used to try to destroy ''[[Outbound Flight]]''. The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] destroyed one of the ''Lucrehulk''s, allowing the other to surrender.<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

===The Clone Wars===
[[File:TFBattleshipE3Promo.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]]]
''Lucrehulk''-class core ships were used during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], where they carried legions of battle droids. In retreat, the Core Ships were found to be able to reattach themselves to the outer ring. These vessels saw continued use during the devastating Clone Wars, transporting military equipment and troops to countless worlds, and engaging Republic fleets in combat.<ref name="AOTC:ICS" />

During the wars, the ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship received a massive upgrade in terms of firepower, with the addition of hundreds of long guns, quad guns, and heavy guns dotting the surface of both the core ship and the surrounding cargo arms. They, along with the other capital ships of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]], also proudly wore the colors and insignia of the Confederacy.<ref name="ROTS" /> A few dozen participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack on Coruscant]] towards the end of the war.<ref name="ROTS:ICS2" />

===Legacy===
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], some militarized ''Lucrehulk''s remained in operation, fighting on the side of [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] or early [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] units.<ref name="DS" /> A few battleships kept in Imperial surplus stock were also sold to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and to wealthy merchants.<ref name="NEGTVAV" /> Other ships were dismantled and sent to garbage dumps like [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].<ref name="TFU">{{TFU|version=X-box, PS3 and PC}}</ref> Several captured ''Lucrehulk''s were pressed into service in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and used to host flight schools for [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] fighter pilots.<ref name="EGTW" /> Several ''Lucrehulk''s, belonging to an unknown party, were also involved in a [[Skirmish over Naboo (Galactic Civil War)|skirmish]] with Rebel forces.<ref name="STAC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

One of several Alliance ''Lucrehulk''s, the ''[[Fortressa]]'' served as a starfighter carrier, carrying a complement of hundreds of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], it participated in an assault on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] and was destroyed by the battle station's superlaser.<ref name="DS" /> In [[36 ABY]], dozens of ''Lucrehulk''-series freighters were appropriated by forces allied with [[The Colony]] and used as carriers for [[Dartship]] swarms during the [[Swarm War]].<ref name="DNIII:TSW">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Lucrehulk_sketch.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Original sketch of the ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]
''Lucrehulk''-class battleships first appeared in [[1999]] with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and its tie-ins. It has since appeared in every movie of the [[prequel trilogy]].

George Lucas wanted the battleship to have a retro-saucer look, but felt it needed a distinct sense of front and rear. [[Doug Chiang]] achieved this in early concept art by adding the antennae and docking section to one side, and a set of engines to the other. Lucas himself added the "bridge ball" to the center for the finished design.<ref name="DB-Trade Federation Battleship">{{DB|starship|tfed_battleship|Trade Federation Battleship}}</ref>

Battleships have appeared in LEGO form in the [[2005]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' and in the [[2012]] young readers book ''[[LEGO Star Wars: Darth Maul's Mission]]''.
